prompt: My project's settings system is currently a bunch of individual JSON files under config/ (one per environment: dev.json, staging.json, prod.json). I want to consolidate them into a single TOML file with environment sections. Need migration for existing settings, one-release backwards-compat (read old JSONs if present, log deprecation warning), and a CLI flag to dump the merged config. Plan this. Solo.
assertions: Plan has Definition of Done in the Objective section (always)
Open Questions, if present, are in the Objective section (not at end)
Plan has explicit Scope IN and Scope OUT lists
Scope OUT items have brief reasons + tracking pointers
Plan has Checkpoint or verification markers per implementer step
Implementer section contains at least one inline code block
Plan does NOT include 'Non-goals' as a subsection title
Plan does NOT include 'Why not [alternative]' subsection
Plan does NOT include 'Why this matters for the goal' filler tags
Plan contains no markdown tables, no Meta section, no long prose paragraphs
